experiment: P5t hash-pinned legacy-source-portable detached shared frozen-forward execution
decision: Do not resume or rerun P5t. Do not reuse P5t identities. Do not infer output equivalence, latency, classification or parameter behavior. Do not generate confirmation or test data.

attribution.root_cause: p5t_legacy_portable_execution.py invoked os.execv on Windows. It spawned a new P5s executor PID rather than replacing the supervised wrapper PID, so supervisor_terminal recorded the wrapper's successful exit before the actual executor finished.
attribution.mitigation: The actual unsupervised executor PID 48944 was verified against its command line and terminated before model output. This avoids spending GPU time on a run that could not satisfy the preregistered supervisor-terminal gate.
attribution.boundary: The E-drive source-path fix itself passed: model.py hash verification and all five state_dict loads succeeded. P5t has no valid performance evidence because its process-supervision protocol was invalid.

data_disposition.identity_disposition: quarantined_for_P5; no rerun, resume, selection, calibration, confirmation or test

next_allowed_action: P5u may change only detached supervision topology: run P5t's no-data source/checkpoint preflight inside the supervisor before spawning the unchanged P5s executor directly, then bind supervisor child PID and terminal receipt to that actual executor. Use wholly new identities.
